title: Termwise equivalences induce equivalences of mapping simplices
statement: Use small simplicial sets and categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure] and coherent realization of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. Let $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$ and $B_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow B_n$ be chains of small simplicial sets, and let maps $f_i:A_i\to B_i$ commute with all transition maps. For a chain $Z$, define $M(Z)_r=\coprod_{\alpha:[r]\to[n]}(Z_{\alpha(r)})_r$, with operators $(\alpha,z)\mapsto(\alpha\theta,t^Z_{\alpha(r),\alpha\theta(s)}\theta^*z)$ for $\theta:[s]\to[r]$, where $t^Z_{j,i}:Z_j\to Z_i$ is the chain composite. The induced simplicial map sends $(\alpha,a)$ to $(\alpha,f_{\alpha(r)}(a))$. If every $f_i$ is a categorical equivalence of simplicial sets, then the induced map of mapping simplices $M(A)\to M(B)$ is a categorical equivalence. Consequently, its coherent realization $\mathfrak C[M(A)]\to\mathfrak C[M(B)]$ is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence.
